label: eRASS1 Main/eRASS1 Main
name: eROSITA-DE DR1 Main
description: The eROSITA space X-ray telescope, operated by the German eROSITA Consortium (eROSITA-DE), has released its first data set (DR1) from the SRG/eROSITA all-sky survey (eRASS1). Covering 20,626.5 square degrees of the Western Galactic Hemisphere, the survey includes a range of exposure times, from ~100 seconds at the Ecliptic equator to over 10,000 seconds near the Ecliptic pole, in the 0.6-2.3 keV energy band. The main catalog band fluxes for ~900k sources detected in the 0.2-2.3 keV band (1B).
